import google.auth
from google.cloud import monitoring_v3

def query_metric_window(project_id, metric_type, start_time, end_time):
    credentials, project = google.auth.default()
    client = monitoring_v3.MetricServiceClient(credentials=credentials)
    name = f'projects/{project_id}'
    interval = {
        'start_time': start_time,
        'end_time': end_time,
    }
    request = {
        'name': name,
        'interval': interval,
        'filter': f'metric.type = "{metric_type}"',
    }
    response = client.list_time_series(request=request)
    return response.time_series

import google.auth
from google.cloud import monitoring_v3

def filter_metric_dimensions(project_id, metric_type, start_time, end_time, filter_):
    credentials, project = google.auth.default()
    client = monitoring_v3.MetricServiceClient(credentials=credentials)
    name = f'projects/{project_id}'
    interval = {
        'start_time': start_time,
        'end_time': end_time,
    }
    request = {
        'name': name,
        'interval': interval,
        'filter': f'metric.type = "{metric_type}" AND {filter_}',
    }
    response = client.list_time_series(request=request)
    return response.time_series

import google.auth
from google.cloud import monitoring_v3
from.observability_client import get_client, get_project_id
from.observability_models import MetricRequest, MetricResponse

def metric_summary(project_id, metric_type, start_time, end_time):
    client = get_client()
    request = MetricRequest(project_id, metric_type, start_time, end_time)
    response = client.list_time_series(request.__dict__)
    return MetricResponse(response.time_series)

from google.cloud import translate_v2 as translate

def translate_text(text, target_language):
    translate_client = translate.Client()
    result = translate_client.translate(text, target_language=target_language)
    return result['translatedText']

import google.auth
from google.cloud import storage

def archive_metric_snapshot(bucket_name, source_file_name, destination_blob_name):
    credentials, project = google.auth.default()
    storage_client = storage.Client(credentials=credentials)
    bucket = storage_client.bucket(bucket_name)
    blob = bucket.blob(destination_blob_name)
    blob.upload_from_filename(source_file_name)
